name: TF Simplification
aliases: TF Simplification — Error-tolerance window algorithm for TF, TF Line Segment Reduction
definition: A technique to reduce the number of line segments in a hand-drawn Transfer Function to improve rendering speed, using an error-tolerance window algorithm.
summary: TF Simplification reduces hand-drawn transfer function segments using an error-tolerance window algorithm that enforces strict geometric constraints to minimize computational overhead for ambient occlusion.
